pr_title: Change default American Option Pricing model to Binomial CRR model
pr_body:
<!--- Provide a general summary of your changes in the Title above -->

#### Description
Change default American Option Pricing model to Binomial CRR model, as it is the most accurate and computational efficient model when compared to IB's modeled Greeks. Same has been compared for European options to select BSM.

#### Related Issue
closes #7408

#### Motivation and Context
The current default model `BjerksundStensland` is not working to calculate American put's delta

Previous unit test values were generated, but now it is fetched from official IB 

#### Requires Documentation Change
https://www.quantconnect.com/docs/v2/writing-algorithms/reality-modeling/options-models/pricing#06-Default-Behavior

#### How Has This Been Tested?
- Unit test for error margin comparison
- regression test on the necessity of model change

issue_context.title: Default option pricing model does not work on American put options
issue_context.body:
<!--- This template provides sections for bugs and features. Please delete any irrelevant sections before submitting -->

#### Expected Behavior
Theoretical Price and Greeks should be accurate without need of specifying the option pricing model

#### Actual Behavior
Greeks are inaccurate for American put options using the default `BjerksundStensland` model, as the 1993 version cannot handle discrete dividends.

#### Potential Solution
Change the default model to another one that supports the function.

#### Reproducing the Problem
The put option delta values are incorrect in the following backtest:
https://www.quantconnect.com/terminal/processCache?request=embedded_backtest_8c215227f6ef63ae8e93ca520952d3d9.html

#### System Information
NA
